user.title: Dashboard Base
user.description: Choose a name for the sidebar item and the entities your dashboard may see and control. You can upload your HTML dashboard now or later. Without an upload, a short message saying nothing has been uploaded yet is shown.

data_description.entities: Only these entities are visible to the dashboard. Scenes and scripts you add may do more than this list.
data_description.html: One self-contained .html file (up to 2 MB, no external resources).

error.html_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
error.html_invalid: The file is not a valid UTF-8 file with HTML.
